reviewSamples.author: Luz Casallas
reviewSamples.text: I had an amazing experience at scandell mobile detailing. The staff is incredibly friendly and attentive, always ready to help. The convenience of their mobility is a huge plus since they come right to your location, and their flexible scheduling makes it even easier. Highly recommended!!

reviewSamples.author: Kevin Eduardo Guerra Monterroso
reviewSamples.text: Excellent service! My car looks brand new super clean, shiny, and detailed to perfection. Highly recommend Scandell Mobile Auto Detailing!!!

reviewSamples.author: Pedro Sanchez
reviewSamples.text: He did an amazing job cleaning my car. I recommend him with my eyes close

reviewSamples.author: Kevin Rathvon
reviewSamples.text: I had both my cars detailed and both came out looking GREAT. Pricing is very fair. I highly recommend using Scandell Mobile Detailing.

reviewSamples.author: Cindy Rathvon
reviewSamples.text: What a fantastic job!  My car looks like brand new!  Dependable and honest young man!  I very highly recommend!   Great job!!!!!

prices_note: No published price list found anywhere (no website, no social media menu). Services presented without fixed prices, with a 'quoted per job, call for a quote' note, per pipeline variant rules.
language_note: No Instagram/Facebook posts to sample. All 5 verbatim Google reviews found are written in English; no clear Spanish-language signal, so default language 'en' per PIPELINE.md rule.
base_note: Automotive detailing niche; dark-v2 is the direct reference base per FORGE-BRIEF (prestigeautocargo precedent, another Miami car business).
